commands.name: template-parses-and-rm-ask-rule-gone
commands.run: python3 -c "import json,sys; p=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl'))['permissions']; sys.exit(0 if 'Bash(rm:*)' not in p['ask'] and 'Bash(rm:*)' not in p['allow'] and p['defaultMode']=='auto' else 1)"

commands.name: template-ask-rules-exact
commands.run: python3 -c "import json,sys; p=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl'))['permissions']; sys.exit(0 if p['ask']==['Bash(git push --force:*)','Bash(git push -f:*)','Bash(git push --force-with-lease:*)','Bash(git push --mirror:*)','mcp__plugin_atlassian_atlassian__createJiraIssue'] else 1)"

commands.name: template-deny-floor-empty
commands.run: python3 -c "import json,sys; p=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl'))['permissions']; sys.exit(0 if p['deny']==[] else 1)"

commands.name: template-registers-rm-guard-hook
commands.run: python3 -c "import json,sys; tmpl=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl'))['hooks']['PreToolUse']; cmds=[h['command'] for e in tmpl if e.get('matcher')=='Bash' for h in e['hooks']]; sys.exit(0 if cmds==['~/.claude/hooks/commit_guard.py','~/.claude/hooks/no_ai_attribution_bash.py','~/.claude/hooks/push_guard.py','~/.claude/hooks/herdr_worktree_guard.py','~/.claude/hooks/rm_guard.py'] else 1)"

commands.name: claude-hooks-suite-has-permissions-checks
commands.run: HOME="$(mktemp -d)" sh claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^PASS  permissions: ' | grep -qx 3

commands.name: claude-hooks-suite-has-rm-guard-checks
commands.run: HOME="$(mktemp -d)" sh claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^PASS  rmg: ' | grep -qx 57

commands.name: claude-links-suite-with-rm-guard-hook-delivery
commands.run: sh install/claude-links.test.sh 2>/dev/null | tee /dev/stderr | grep -q '^PASS  link path registers rm_guard.py as a PreToolUse Bash hook' && sh install/claude-links.test.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
